name: Yxlan
description: A long, sparse north-to-south archipelago hike across Yxlan, starting at Köpmanholm and passing pine forest, meadows, narrow roads, cottage areas, historic villages, rocky shoreline, lake Träsket, Hamnviken, cultural traces near Kasberget and the Vadholmen/Yxlan lighthouse area. The current official PDF/Outdooractive route is about 22.4 km after the August 2025 route change. The trail is not physically SAT-marked; follow the local tourist map's green-dotted route or the official interactive map/GPX.
utilities: Services are sparse for a 20+ km section. Carry drinking water and food from Furusund/Köpmanholm, and treat Köpmanholms Lanthandel as an opening-dependent shop/food stop, not a public water point.

Köpmanholms Lanthandel / Grill & Bar / Nina's kiosk is the main shop/food/conditional-resupply candidate and SAT points hikers there for local map/info. Iterations 2-4 found current operator/social evidence for small year-round grocery/convenience and grill/bar service, with March 2026 activity and sale-listing/open-year-round evidence, but opening, grill/bar availability and future ownership should be checked before relying on it.

No confirmed public drinking-water refill was found in iterations 1-5. Private Hamnviken water taps/pumphouses appear to be association/member infrastructure and should not be exposed as public water.

Hamnholmen toilet is OSM/Wikimedia-backed with 2025 check metadata and Hamnviken rules mention a torrdass, but local association context makes public-access wording sensitive; keep it as a cautious dry-toilet candidate.

No public guest-harbor showers, waste stations, sopmaja pins or water services comparable to Furusund were confirmed on Yxlan. Norrtälje has mapped sopmajor for temporary visitors generally, but no specific Yxlan sopmaja was text-confirmed; pack out waste and do not use private bins.

Östervikens badplats is an official Norrtälje bathing place with beach, benches/tables, fireplace and parking but no toilet, kiosk/cafe, changing room, jetty or ladder; dogs are not allowed at public bathing places May 15-September 15.

Yxlö brygga grillplats and Hamnholmen toilet remain useful community/map-supported facilities with source caveats. Hamnvikens badplats and Hamnviken outdoor gym should be suppressed from final facilities.
waterSources: Carry enough water for the full section unless Köpmanholms Lanthandel / Nina's kiosk is confirmed open and sufficient for purchase/refill needs.
No dependable public drinking-water source was confirmed mid-route in iterations 1-5.
Do not expose Hamnviken samfällighet taps or pumphouses as public drinking water unless permission/public access is confirmed.
Lake Träsket and bathing places are not drinking-water sources.
notes: Route shape: linear / point-to-point north-to-south section, normally started at Köpmanholm ferry terminal with bus/ferry logistics planned around the farthest southern point reached.
Navigation: Yxlan is not SAT-marked; use official GPX/interactive map and the local tourist map's green-dotted route.

The August 8, 2025 route change removed the old loop around the southern lake because beavers made that route almost impossible to pass; use current official maps. Treat this as a use-current-map note, not an active closure.
Road safety: expect some walking near narrow country roads and be cautious around traffic.
Lighthouse detour/access: official SAT says follow the map both out and back and do not walk through the housing community.
Dogs must be leashed March-September according to SAT; national extra-control rules also apply March 1-August 20.
Dogs are not allowed at Norrtälje municipal public bathing places May 15-September 15.
Parking on Yxlan is difficult and discouraged by SAT; prefer bus/boat or parking in Furusund.
Nearby bird/seal protection areas and sensitive shore environments mean users should not improvise off-route landings or detours onto small islets.
Standard archipelago cautions apply: check fire bans, avoid green/murky algal-bloom water, protect dogs/children from algae exposure, and do tick checks in Stockholm coastal TBE-risk areas.

facilities.name: Köpmanholms Lanthandel, Grill & Bar / Nina's kiosk
facilities.description: Main Yxlan shop/food/conditional-resupply/map-info candidate near Köpmanholm. SAT points hikers to Nina's kiosk for the local map and Q&A lists Köpmanholms Lanthandel as the Yxlan food shop; SAT winter/low-season notes support food purchase and customer-context toilet. Operator/social evidence shows activity in March 2026 and sale-listing material says open year-round, but opening and grill/bar availability are date-sensitive and the business was listed for sale; do not treat as guaranteed full grocery, public/free toilet or public water refill.

facilities.name: Östervikens badplats
facilities.description: Official Norrtälje bathing place on north/east Yxlan with beach, benches/tables, fireplace and parking. Important caveats: no toilet, drinking water, kiosk/cafe, changing room, shower, jetty or ladder; bathing-place season is May 15-September 15 and dogs are not allowed at public bathing places during that period. Do not let the parking listing override SAT's general warning that Yxlan parking is limited and discouraged.

facilities.name: Hamnholmen toilet
facilities.description: Cautious simple dry-toilet candidate near Hamnviken/Hamnholmen. OSM/Wikimedia support a free 24/7 pit latrine checked 2025-05-05 with no handwashing, and Hamnviken rules mention a torrdass, but no official SAT/Norrtälje confirmation was found and association/common-area context weakens public-access certainty.

facilities.name: Yxlö brygga grillplats
facilities.description: Simple cement-ring grill/rest spot near Yxlö brygga, supported by OSM/Wikimedia/Grillplatser. Do not assume water, toilet, firewood or official maintenance; only use if current fire bans allow.

facilities.name: Jungfruringen / Labyrinten på Kasberget
facilities.description: Cultural/heritage POI near Köpmanholm/Kasberget, also described as Trojeborg in Roslagen material. Treat as archaeological/fragile stone labyrinth; view respectfully and do not move or disturb stones.

facilities.name: Träsket
facilities.description: Approximate scenic lake/natural route feature. Rest/scenery context only; not drinking water, not camping, not swimming, and not the old lake-loop route.

facilities.name: Yxlan / Vadholmen lighthouse
facilities.description: Official route highlight and viewpoint/cultural POI. Follow the mapped route out and back; do not cut through the housing community. No camping or facility claim.
